claims.text: Rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside.
The glass carries condensation, and droplets merge and leave wavering trails.
Amber, white, and faint green city lights blur and streak beyond the wet pane.
Rain taps against the glass over a low engine hum and the faint hiss of tires on wet asphalt.

description.text: At night, rain clings to the glass of a moving bus window, filling the foreground with clear beads, cloudy patches of condensation, and thin trails where earlier drops have already run. Beyond the wet pane, the city is a soft field of amber, white, and faint green lights, with dark building silhouettes sliding steadily from right to left. A few fresh drops strike the outer glass and flatten, nudging nearby beads together. Small droplets tremble in place, then merge into heavier drops that swell and begin to wander down the glass in wavering lines. The reflections of passing lights stretch and fold across the curved surface, so the outside world feels close but indistinct. A faint mist gathers near the lower edge of the frame, and the dim interior of the bus remains as a shadowed border around the brighter street beyond. The whole pane seems to breathe with the motion of the ride, water and reflected light shifting against the dark.
Rain beads on the bus window at night, with blurred city lights beyond the glass.
Several droplets merge and begin to slide in wavering lines.
Rain taps softly against the glass over a low engine hum.
Reflected streetlights stretch across the wet pane as the city slips past.

A closer view settles on the misted glass. A single large droplet hangs near the center, catching a bright point of city light; it quivers, breaks loose, and draws a clear track through the condensation as it slides downward. Around it, smaller beads jump and merge, leaving broken trails that catch the amber and white glow from outside. Beyond the pane, the night city keeps moving in long, blurred streaks, and the dark shapes of buildings pass without sharp edges. The glass itself becomes the main subject: cool, wet, and textured by rain, with the pulse of the bus and the wet road implied in the steady drift of the reflected lights. More droplets gather along the droplet's track, wavering before they follow, while a thin film of moisture softens every point of light into a glow. The surface stays in close detail, its tiny rivers and beads shifting continuously against the night beyond.
A large droplet hangs at the center of the misted glass, catching a point of light.
The droplet breaks loose and draws a clear track through the condensation.
A faint tire hiss and steady engine note continue beneath the rain.
Amber and white city lights smear in long streaks beyond the glass.
